note: Rewritten from Silvestri 1914, the original being a Latin diagnosis (Miles minor / Miles major / Operarius) followed by Italian (collecting and ecology); the type locality is "Victoria, Cameroon", and the author obtained only a very few specimens in a gallery about 10 cm below ground. The original work is the Bollettino del Laboratorio di Zoologia Generale e Agraria di Portici, vol. 9 (1914–1915). The original uses the comma as decimal separator (4,5 = 4.5 mm), which is changed to a decimal point here; OCR misprints (eremeum, artieulatis, elypeo, ee and so on) have been read by context. The frontal and lateral views of the soldier head in plate LXXII have not been translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The species differs clearly from all the other known species of the genus in the shape of the soldier frons (the specific name diversifrons refers to the form of the frons).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Small soldier (Miles minor): body straw yellow, head ochraceous, mandibles black except at the base. Head slightly longer than wide, stout, almost vertically truncate in front; fontanelle slightly projecting; labrum almost square, the middle of the anterior margin broadly rounded, the lateral corners short, projecting, rather narrow and sharp. Mandibles slightly longer than the head, gradually tapering, only slightly curved, apex sharp. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 longer than segment 4 by 0.5 times, segment 5 almost 0.5 times longer than segment 4. Anterior lobe of the pronotum deeply concave at the median margin. Legs sparsely hairy, the outer apical spine of the middle tibia rather long and stout. Abdominal tergites and sternites with very small hairs and, posteriorly, some short hairs and rather long hairs. Measurements (mm): body length 4.5; head length 1.45, head width 1.20; mandible length 1.50; antennal length 1.70; hind tibia 0.91. Large soldier (Miles major): differing in the brick-red head (ferrugineo-latericio) and slightly larger size.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body straw yellow, head ivory white, abdomen grey owing to the food contents. Head above with shorter, short and rather long hairs; clypeus fairly swollen; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 sometimes showing a very faint trace of division and slightly longer than segment 4, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4. Anterior lobe of the pronotum slightly concave at the median margin. Abdominal tergites and sternites with many shorter hairs and, posteriorly, some short or rather long hairs. Measurements (mm): body length 4; head length 0.78, head width 0.88; antennal length 1.04; hind tibia 0.80.
